factsheet.heading: London Mithraeum Bloomberg SPACE
paragraphs: Bloomberg's European HQ is a remarkable 21st century building, home to a Roman Temple built in 240, and a remarkable selection of Roman artefacts discovered on the site. The site also play host to contemporary art installations exploring ancient shrines and traditions.

factsheet.heading: Family Day
paragraphs: Join London Mithraeum Bloomberg SPACE for a creative family day inspired by the new art installation Folkmoot by Anne Ryan. Explore the exhibition, craft your own artwork and follow a wildlife trail through the space.

Step into Anne Ryan’s colourful installation Folkmoot, where sculptures, paintings and friezes bring together animals, people, ancient objects and stories from London’s past and present. Take inspiration from the artworks to shape and build your own sculptural creation, then follow the wildlife trail to discover birds, beasts and other creatures hidden throughout the installation and among the Roman artefacts on display.
Afterwards, continue your journey beneath the city and discover the atmospheric Temple of Mithras.
Aimed at children aged 5–11, but all ages are welcome.

Please book a 30-minute time slot.
